title: Latihan Kebakaran
subject: an office's monthly fire drill in a KL tower, everyone walking down 23 floors to the assembly point still carrying their nasi lemak
caption: Malaysian Britpop-style pop rock, mid-90s British guitar pop through a Malay lens. Chiming jangly twelve-string electric guitar riff, chunky overdriven rhythm guitar, melodic walking bass, tambourine on every beat, swirling Hammond organ fills. Bright live-band room sound, guitars wide, driving snare. Male mid-range lead with nasal swagger and a terrace-style group chorus. 128 BPM, E major. Bouncy, chaotic and self-mocking. No autotune, no pop-punk palm mutes, no metal riffs, no EDM, no ballad slowdown.
lyrics:
[Intro - twelve-string riff, tambourine and organ]

[Verse 1]
Pukul sepuluh, loceng berbunyi
Nasi lemak baru buka bungkus
Bos kata, ini latihan je
Turun semua, bawa kad pekerja

[Pre-Chorus]
Tingkat dua puluh tiga
Sambal aku ikut sekali

[Chorus]
Latihan kebakaran
Satu menara turun beramai
Bungkus daun pisang dalam tangan
Kita makan kat tempat berkumpul

[Verse 2]
Tingkat lapan, kasut tumit tinggi
Kak Ros tanggal, jalan kaki ayam
Abang IT bawa laptop dan kopi
Semua orang dah kenal semua

[Pre-Chorus]
Warden kira nama kita
Seorang masih dalam tandas

[Chorus]
Latihan kebakaran
Dua puluh minit kita merayau
Telur rebus aku dah habis
Bulan depan, kita bawa roti

[Outro - group chorus and organ, riff fades]
